page.overview:
Who is Calico Cat Parent?

The Calico Cat Parents are the parents of the calico kittens found in Lake Lapcat in Bowser's Fury.

The Calico Cat Parents resemble their kids, but are bigger. Three different parents appear in the game, each one found near each of the three Giga Bells.

The parent cries when its kittens went missing.

When Mario first encounters one in his adventures, she is shown crying, due to her kittens having gone missing.
